titles.value: 花心大少 / Hong Kong Playboys

descriptions.value: 严钱声是一名自恃追女高手的富家花花公子，被母亲劝喻要成家立室。他在寻找生命中的女主角时，被两个追女高手挑战。到底他最后能否找到心中最爱?
在一次车祸后失忆的王人杰找到夜间警卫的工作。午夜，他准时抵达废弃的大厦上班，却发现三只冤魂如约而至，并揭发了一场复仇计划。究竟这是命运的安排还是邪灵的诅咒？

titles.value: 铁线功夫拳 / Iron Kung Fu Fist

descriptions.value: 武术宗师梁坤为保护心爱的女人毅然退隐江湖，不料他的隐忍却换来了爱人的惨死。意识到宿命避无可避，他重返武林，在丐帮帮主苏灿的鼎力相助下，梁坤杀出一条血路，誓要向那些冷血仇敌讨回血债。
消失三年的鬼手及其盗墓团伙重现江城，再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盗墓贼在开棺时遇惊魂邪煞，逃离后又接连惨死家中。最终古墓尸毒和针孔成为留给警察沈春合仅有的线索，看似普通的盗墓案，瞬间扑朔迷离疑点重重。
骄横军阀侯杰在惨遭亲信曹蛮残酷背叛、痛失至爱幼女后，心灰意冷下大彻大悟投身少林隐姓埋名。不料野心勃勃的叛将曹蛮紧随其后引兵屠城，使千年古刹少林危在旦夕。已皈依佛门的侯杰重拾昔日信念，在这场充满血色的因果轮回中，誓以血肉之躯筑起最后的救赎。

titles.value: 无敌幸运星 / When Fortune Smiles

descriptions.value: 富翁死前立下遗嘱，把财富全留给女儿飞飞，逼使其子秋少及侄儿大傻设法分一杯羹。大傻派小混混幸运星往偷遗嘱，欲在遗嘱上做手脚，而秋少亦找来貌似其妹的阿凤假扮飞飞骗取遗嘱。幸运星打算骗”假飞飞”结婚以夺取遗产，不料二人日久生情，最终幸运星在婚礼日揭发二人的诡计。

titles.value: 黑白潜行2 / The Grey Men 2

descriptions.value: 在莱咖国政权交替之际，黑帮头目宋邦企图藉此洗白身份，欲坐上市长宝座。为了筹措庞大资金，他与官员勾结行贿，却仍面临严重的资金缺口。于是，宋邦的得力助手郑咤和打手苏万杀人越货、横行作恶，逐步帮助他巩固权力。正当宋邦自以为能坐享其成时，三人的关系却突然逆转…
日本侵华后，咏春大师叶问与家人因生活艰难离开佛山，远赴香港开馆收徒，希望可以开展新生活。但事情并未如所想般容易，他欲在香港开武馆，就必须接受各大门派的挑战。一场又一场的功夫较量正式展开！
有妇之夫孙子威与莉发展婚外情，其妻宝儿忍无可忍，决定离婚。分居后，宝儿认识一群独身但不甘寂寞的女人，经常聚会，各自各精彩！子威后来发觉自己最爱的依然是宝儿，二人决定复合。怎料在庆祝复合的晚会上，二人经过一场争吵，竟宣布第二度离异...

titles.value: 南北妈打 / Mother VS Mother

descriptions.value: 关德兴年青时与李消云相恋，遭母亲反对，只好和周申玉结婚。关的儿子关仁坚工作上认识了文文。申玉发现儿子追求的女友文文，竟是消云的女儿。两个妈打情敌又一次碰头，再斗个你死我活。

descriptions.value: 李子良丧妻后，与两个儿子相依为命。妻子的巨额医药费令子良经济十分拮据，受同事教唆往马场孤注一掷，迫得向高利贷借款，从此子良债台高筑，疲于奔命，没有时间与儿子沟通，父子疏离。与此同时高利贷不断登门恐吓，骚扰儿子，最终弄至悲剧发生…
天才拳击手徐佳阳为了替父亲还赌债在地下酒馆打黑拳时被举报，痛失奥运资格赛，陨落拳坛。十年后，铁血教练陈丽月决要助她实现父亲的遗愿，重回拳坛找回昔日的自己。当拳击的热血碰上责任时，曾经失落的拳击梦能否再度燃烧？

titles.value: 望夫成龙 / Love Is Love

descriptions.value: 在乡间长大的情侣石金水和吴带娣青梅竹马，但娣父反对他们在一起，于是二人搬到市区共同生活。带娣为助金水找到一份推销员工作，暗中当舞小姐为其筹款。金水因工作勤奋，受上司赏识，加以提拔。虽然工作发展如意，但金水渐渐发觉自己与带娣的距离越来越远...

titles.value: 赤脚小子 / The Bare-footed Kid

descriptions.value: 穷乡青年关丰曜，终日赤着双脚，以背人过河为活。关父临终前，嘱其出城投靠段青云；段骤见故人之子，留下关在布店当小工。关与私塾女教师华小莲交心，却遭莲父白眼；关为求出人头地，竟往投靠土霸喀和布，结果连累莲父与段相继被喀暗算身亡。关得知真相，惜为时已晚，追悔莫及，决与喀拼过死活...
茅山师父九叔受委托为富翁起棺迁葬，祈求新墓地能催财。惟富翁之尸体出现尸变后，变成殭尸，并在村内四处为害。此时，九叔的两名徒弟亦分别被殭尸所伤和受女鬼迷惑。九叔如何同时面对徒弟们生死存亡，以及殭尸为害的问题呢？
张铁柱是一名出色的警长，他刚烈的办案风格却遭到上司和同僚的不满。当他意外发现偷车贼伟仔为追捕持枪劫匪的关键人物，两人不得不携手将罪犯绳之以法。

titles.value: 替枪老豆 / Let's Have a Baby

descriptions.value: 万与夏婚后多年忽想生育，但万被证实不育，让夏接受人工受孕；但万心中仍感怪异，内心矛盾弄得精神紧张，行为乖张，闹出不少笑话；万在夏平安产子前后，屡有奇异幻想，误会连场，猜疑甚多，更怀疑夏与任职于夏威夷精子银行的表哥潘震伟有染，不是人工受孕，而是被人受孕。
就读女校高中的婷婷，因排演《罗密欧与朱丽叶》而与邻校男生Jackson戏假情真，爱情就在排练时萌芽。这是婷婷的初恋，但Jaskson却是一个变幻莫测的爱情玩家…

titles.value: 逃学威龙 2 / Fight Back to School II

descriptions.value: 周星星遭降职后愤而辞去警职，私自潜入一所国际学校，调查国际恐怖分子的阴谋。期间，他意外发现探员达叔正假扮成教师。两人随即连手，共同对抗全副武装的罪犯，展开一场终极对决。
为了对抗温室效应，女科学家颜欣培育出超级橡胶种子，前往一个荒岛进行种植，希望将那里改变为一片欣欣向荣的新土地。然而，她的前夫决定在这趟危险的旅程中保护她，与她结伴同行。抵达后，他们面临接连不断的冲突，并遇上当地的贩毒组织，一场生死对决随即展开。

titles.value: 缘份 / Behind the Yellow Line

descriptions.value: 一个刚毕业的年青人在地铁站内邂逅一个美丽动人的女子，并对她一见钟情。在另一方面，他正被一个富家女展开追求。而此时他倾心的那女子，也正周旋于一个已婚男子之中。当那年青人向她表白时，那女子要求与他在地铁站内玩捉迷藏来决定大家的缘份！

titles.value: 男与女 / Hong Kong Hong Kong

descriptions.value: 偷渡客孟思晨匿居于山边木屋区，沦为众男工具，期间结识非法拳师江远生，并发生雾水情缘。后来思晨下嫁中年木匠贵叔，生活虽安稳，心灵却空虚。意外再遇远生后，难免干柴烈火，未几更有孕...
偷渡到东京的铁头与一帮华人在当地艰难求生，并逐渐建立起一股黑帮新势力。当铁头取得居留权，决心退出江湖、展开新生活时，势力的急速扩张却引来各方势力围剿。面对警方大举扫黑，加上兄弟无情出卖，他最终被迫重返江湖。

titles.value: 破坏之王 / Love on Delivery

descriptions.value: 外卖员何金银为让他的女神阿丽对他刮目相看，发奋习武，并学了奇怪的招式。胆小怕事的他一次头戴加菲猫面具拯救了阿丽，不料事后被空手道大师段水流领功。银为揭穿真相，最终在擂台使出绝招“无敌风火轮”击败段大师，并抱得美人归。

In 2019, Tesla was running on fumes. Shanghai handed it a lifeline, a gigafactory built in 10 months. Today, that plant produces nearly half of all Teslas using 95% local parts. That same playbook is expanding across green tech, pairing Chinese battery tech with American software. 
When the world's two largest economies build together, clean energy gets cheaper and faster for everyone.

titles.value: Why we need openness&sharing in the Al era

descriptions.value: Three years ago, ChatGPT was almost the only answer to the question, "Which LLM is best?" Today, the gap between top Chinese and US models has narrowed to just 2.7%, with the two taking turns wearing the crown. US firms run on China's low-cost open-source models, while Chinese labs build on US frontier research. Openness isn't idealism-it's pragmatism. This episode of Beyond Competition explains why.

titles.value: Why does a new drug require joint R&D?

descriptions.value: China has a third of the world's innovative drugs-in-development, while the US contributes 55% of global biopharma R&D investment. When these strengths meet, multi-billion-dollar partnerships follow - and patients worldwide benefit. In this episode, we explore why drug development knows no borders.

titles.value: How fresh produce connects two agricultural powerhouses

descriptions.value: China-US farm trade hit $14.1 billion in the first half of 2026, that's around $78 million worth agricultural produce crossing the Pacific every day. From American soybeans in China's soy milk to Chinese garlic on US supermarket shelves, one table feeds two nations. In episode, let's follow the food trade.

titles.value: Why is energy transition a shared challenge for China and the US?

descriptions.value: In 2025, China added over 430 GW of new wind and solar capacity while the US added 53 GW - 80% of it solar and storage. Eight of every 10 solar modules worldwide are made in China, driving down global clean energy costs for everyone. In this episode, let’s explore why the energy transition demands cooperation, not walls.

titles.value: Why the aviation revolution depends on global collaboration

descriptions.value: More than 10,000 Boeing jets worldwide fly with Chinese-made parts, while Boeing's Shanghai facility services airlines from China and beyond. The world's two largest aviation markets will need over 43,000 new aircraft in the next 20 years. In this episode, we see how one plane lifts off on the strength of an entire global supply chain.

In this episode, Tianran He visits Suzhou, a historic city in eastern China famously admired by Marco Polo. Crisscrossed by canals, Suzhou is renowned for its exquisite gardens, where ancient scholars recreated nature's beauty within their own homes. Sanxingdui Site is located at Guanghan, Sichuan Province. It is a site of an ancient city, ancient kingdom and ancient Shu culture in southwest of China, which is the largest in area, longest in time span and richest in cultural connotation. The total area covers 12 square kilometers, which was built over 3000 years ago. The cultural relics at Sanxingdui are precious cultural heritage of mankind, which contain rich historical, cultural and scientific value, and bespeak themselves as the most attractive ones amongst the multitude of the spectacular relics in China.
In this episode, under the guide of the presenter, we visit the Sanxingdui Site Garden, archaeological Site and Sanxingdui Museum, show the amazing giant bronze mask, exquisite gold stuff, marvelous bronze divine tree etc., re-explore this mysterious and great civilization 3000 years ago.
